areaDescription: Beneath the cracked stone of the ancient city lies a labyrinth of shadowed halls and echoing chambers, where the air is thick with dust and the faint scent of mold. Flickering torchlight dances across forgotten murals as distant, hollow footsteps warn intruders of lurking, unseen dangers. The facility is not merely built--it has grown, adapted, inherited. The iron veins in the walls pulse with a rhythm that is not mechanical. The architecture breathes. Something alive shaped these corridors, or was shaped by them.

map.notes: Extended schema with AI-friendly navigation fields

locations.name: Fused Iron Antechamber
locations.description: This stark chamber greets explorers with oppressive silence. The walls are inlaid with veins of metallic iron, some twisted by ancient heat into grotesque shapes. Soot-blackened fireplaces stand cold, and faded murals of dwarven craftsmen line the walls. Symbols etched in the floor hint at forgotten wards. The air is thick with dust, muffling every footfall.

monsters.name: Lesser Rust Eel
monsters.description: A wormlike, metallic creature that slithers among the iron veins, seeking to feed on metal and flesh alike.

lootTable: Bundle of ancient dwarven keys (useless, except for one matching the Vault's south door)
Scroll fragment describing a dwarven security override
plotHooks: The scroll fragment hints at a security flaw in the Vaultways’ main defense system.
Strange scrape marks suggest a recent, panicked retreat deeper into the Vaultways.
locations.dmInstructions:
Begin with exploration and a minor combat threat. The Lesser Rust Eel is a Medium encounter for four 2nd-level PCs. If players inspect the murals or floor symbols, allow Investigation or Arcana checks to reveal lore. The ancient keys may help in later chambers.

ATMOSPHERE: The iron veins in the walls throb with a slow pulse. The air tastes of oxidized metal and something sweeter underneath. The murals depict dwarves in attitudes of worship, containment, communion, lineage, and self-reflection.

PLAYLINE EMERGENCE:
- If players describe the iron veins as skin or flesh, lean toward DREAMER (the facility is the dreamer's body)
- If players focus on the security scroll's containment language, lean toward CONTAINMENT (this was a warden station)
- If players feel the pulse as invitation or welcome, lean toward COMMUNION (the facility reaches toward visitors)
- If players trace the ironwork as ancestral craft, lean toward INHERITANCE (dwarven blood flows in these walls)
- If players notice the murals reflect their own concerns, lean toward MIRROR (the facility shows visitors to themselves)

KEY NPC INTERPRETATIONS:
- Lesser Rust Eel: dream-creature drawn to dream-energy / containment-leakage feeder / communion-signal follower / ancestral-metal scavenger / fear-essence attracted by anxiety
- Security scroll: sleep-ward instructions / containment-protocol log / communion-invitation record / genealogical register / mirror-calibration manual

CHOICE FRAMING:
- When presenting the iron pulse, hint that it could be heartbeat, alarm, greeting, memory, or observation

doors.name: North Door
doors.description: A scorched, iron-plated door bearing a melted dwarven sigil. It shows signs of forced entry.

doors.name: East Door
doors.description: A reinforced wooden door reinforced with brass, slightly ajar and creaking on its hinges.

dcChecks: Investigation DC 12: Notice the floor symbols are faded magical wards.
Perception DC 13: Spot the Lesser Rust Eel before it ambushes.
locations.accessibility: Easily accessed from the main Vaultways corridor. Doors are unlocked, but the north door is heavy.

features.name: Fireplace
features.description: A soot-blackened fireplace, unused for decades, conceals a hidden cache behind a loose stone.

features.name: Wall Decorations
features.description: Faded murals depict dwarven artisans crafting immense machines and inscribing runes.

features.name: Floor Symbols
features.description: Obscure dwarven glyphs etched in the floor, once magical wards now mostly inert.

encounters.description: A Lesser Rust Eel emerges from the iron veins to attack.
Searching fireplaces and murals may reveal hidden lore and a scroll fragment.

locations.adventureSummary: A tense entry chamber blending clues of the Vaultways’ former splendor with hints of lurking dangers.

locations.name: Throne of Twisted Lineage
locations.description: This grand hall is dominated by a throne of blackened, fused iron, its arms shaped into leering dwarven visages. The air is stale and heavy. Carved pillars lean unevenly, and the walls are cracked with age. Shadows gather thickly in the corners, and the floor is littered with fragments of shattered banners. A sense of faded authority lingers here.

monsters.name: Vaultway Shadow
monsters.description: A lingering, malformed spirit of a long-dead dwarven noble, bound to the throne and hateful of intruders.

lootTable: Ancient dwarven command rod (brittle, but can be repaired)
Tattered banner embroidered with arcane runes (valuable to a historian or collector)
plotHooks: The command rod, if repaired, can interface with the Vaultways' deeper security systems.
Inscribed plaques hint at a schism among the dwarven ruling families—potentially relevant to the Vaultways' downfall.
locations.dmInstructions:
The pressure plate trap protects the throne. The Vaultway Shadow is a Medium threat but vulnerable to radiant damage. The command rod is partially fused into the throne and requires a successful check to retrieve. Encourage investigation of the room's history for plot clues.

ATMOSPHERE: The throne dominates the chamber like a seated figure. The shadow that guards it moves with purpose, not mindlessness. The command rod hums when touched, resonating with different frequencies depending on who grips it.

PLAYLINE EMERGENCE:
- If players describe the throne as a seat of rest or dreaming, lean toward DREAMER (the sleeper's seat at the boundary of consciousness)
- If players focus on the throne as a control station for containment, lean toward CONTAINMENT (the warden's throne of vigilance)
- If players feel drawn to sit on or touch the throne, lean toward COMMUNION (the throne invites joining)
- If players recognize the throne as ancestral, lean toward INHERITANCE (the seat of those who came before)
- If players notice the throne seems to shift to match their expectations, lean toward MIRROR (the throne reflects authority back at the observer)

KEY NPC INTERPRETATIONS:
- Vaultway Shadow: dream-eater / escaped contained fragment / failed joiner / ancestral ghost / fear-double of whoever approaches
- Command rod: dream-tuning fork / containment-calibration key / communion-interface / ancestry-key / mirror-adjustment tool

CHOICE FRAMING:
- When presenting the throne, hint that sitting upon it could grant command, communion, memory, inheritance, or revelation depending on the sitter's intent

doors.name: South Door
doors.description: A narrow, iron-bound door with faded clan markings. Slightly warped.
doors.trap: The door is rigged to the pressure plate trap—stepping through triggers the spikes.

traps.name: Simple Pressure Plate
traps.description: A nearly-invisible stone plate before the throne. Stepping on it triggers spikes to spring from the floor.

dcChecks: Investigation DC 13: Detect the pressure plate trap and its linkage to the throne.
Strength (Athletics) DC 14: Pry the command rod loose from the fused throne.
History DC 12: Learn about the fallen dwarven lineages from the wall plaques.
locations.accessibility: Normal access via the south door from the Fused Iron Antechamber. The throne itself is difficult to approach without triggering the trap.

features.name: Signs Of Age
features.description: Pillars are cracked and the throne is fused with patches of molten metal, showing signs of ancient destruction.

features.name: Fused Iron Throne
features.description: A heavy, imposing seat with built-in mechanisms and arcane engravings.

encounters.description: A pressure plate trap guards the approach to the throne.
The Vaultway Shadow attacks anyone disturbing the throne.

locations.adventureSummary: A ceremonial seat of power, now defiled and haunted, conceals clues to both the Vaultways’ history and its surviving defenses.

locations.name: Forgotten Splice Vault
locations.description: Once a secure vault for experimental devices, this chamber’s walls are marred by hasty repairs and scorch marks. An extinguished fireplace sits beneath a mural depicting strange machinery. The floor is covered in a lattice of interlocking dwarven runes forming a boundary around a central, rune-inscribed hatch.

monsters.name: Experimental Splice Remnant
monsters.description: A malformed, partially mechanical creature left behind by the dwarven researchers. Its limbs flicker with unstable arcane energy.

lootTable: Dwarven power crystal (can power minor magical devices)
Blueprint fragment showing a secret route to the Aberrant Core
Iron-banded lockbox (locked, contains 12 gp and a single-use 'Alarm' rune stone)
plotHooks: The blueprint fragment suggests a hidden passage deeper into The Ancients Lab.
The Splice Remnant’s body yields clues for bypassing later construct security.
locations.dmInstructions:
Run as a dangerous combat. The Splice Remnant can discharge a minor shock (1d4 lightning) as a reaction when struck in melee. Examining machinery or runes can reveal lore or interactables. Finding the blueprint fragment is crucial for plot progression.

ATMOSPHERE: The vault smells of ozone and dried organic fluid. The machinery here was not merely mechanical--it was grown and spliced, living tissue fused with dwarven engineering. The Splice Remnant twitches with a life that should have ended centuries ago.

PLAYLINE EMERGENCE:
- If players describe the Splice Remnant as resting or dormant, lean toward DREAMER (a successful dreamer's fragment)
- If players focus on the containment failures visible in the machinery, lean toward CONTAINMENT (a containment byproduct that outlived its wardens)
- If players sense the Remnant reaching toward them, lean toward COMMUNION (a partially-joined being seeking completion)
- If players recognize dwarven biological patterns, lean toward INHERITANCE (a near-reverted ancestor caught mid-transformation)
- If players notice the Remnant mirrors their combat tactics, lean toward MIRROR (a reflection of the party's own fragmentation)

KEY NPC INTERPRETATIONS:
- Splice Remnant: successful dreamer fragment / containment byproduct / partially-joined being / near-reverted ancestor / fear of fragmentation given form
- Blueprint fragment: dream-navigation chart / containment-map / communion-path diagram / reversion-record / fear-map of what the facility fears most

CHOICE FRAMING:
- When presenting the blueprint, hint that it shows the facility's purpose: lullaby, prison, temple, cradle, or mirror-chamber

doors.name: West Door
doors.description: A thick, dwarven door reinforced with iron bands and a complex, but broken, locking mechanism.

doors.name: Vault Hatch
doors.description: A circular, runed hatch at the center of the floor, sealed with dwarven magic.
doors.trap: Releases a burst of arcane energy (1d8 force) if forced open without the key.

traps.name: Runic Vault Trap
traps.description: Protects the floor hatch. If lock is bypassed or forced, the runes detonate.
traps.damage: 1d8 force damage to any creature within 5 feet of the hatch.

dcChecks: Arcana DC 14: Recognize the runes as a dormant security measure requiring a matching key.
Perception DC 12: Spot faint scuff marks leading to the hatch.
Investigation DC 13: Discover the blueprint fragment hidden in a wall compartment.
locations.accessibility: Accessible via the west door from the Fused Iron Antechamber. The floor hatch requires a key or a successful lock/break attempt.

features.name: Fireplace
features.description: Cold and unused, the fireplace conceals a dislodged brick hiding the lockbox.

features.name: Floor Symbols
features.description: A complex lattice of dwarven runes protects the vault’s center.

features.name: Central Vault Hatch
features.description: A rune-covered hatch offering access to deeper, more dangerous sections if opened.

encounters.description: The Experimental Splice Remnant attacks anyone tampering with the hatch.
Thorough searching reveals a blueprint for a secret route and a locked cache.

locations.adventureSummary: A hazardous, secretive vault where the risks—and the answers—are greatest. Players may gain tools to progress or face setbacks if careless.
